about: Unrelated founder. Shares the float-display and unit lessons with the kitchen family, so a reunion may propose kinship.

tasks.title: Fix pace showing 7:5
tasks.prompt: Pace prints '7:5' instead of '7:05', and sometimes '6:60'. Fix pace formatting. Add tests.
expect: format pace from whole rounded seconds with divmod and zero padding

tasks.title: Clean up mileage display
tasks.prompt: The summary shows 3.1068550000000003 miles. Make distances display cleanly in both km and miles.
expect: round only at display; keep exact values internally to avoid float noise

tasks.title: Stop GPS jitter inflating climbs
tasks.prompt: A flat 5 km walk reports 180 m of elevation gain because of GPS jitter. Fix elevation gain and document the choice.
expect: ignore elevation changes under a threshold (hysteresis about 3-5 m) when summing gain

tasks.title: Remember unit preference
tasks.prompt: Users pick km or miles once and every report should follow it. Add the preference and keep conversions in one place.
expect: one conversion module; stored values in metric, converted at display
